title: Abalone-derived dermatopontin and its RFK-containing peptide promote osteogenesis via TGF-beta/Smad signaling pathway.
authors: Soongnart, Purimpuch; Boonkua, Supawich; Thongsum, Orawan; Chantunmapitak, Rueangtip; Wichienwat, Primwadee; Soonsawad, Pan; Weerachatyanukul, Wattana; Supokawej, Aungkura; Asuvapongpatana, Somluk
one_liner_zh: 该文研究鲍鱼来源的dermatopontin及其RFK肽通过TGF-beta/Smad信号促进成骨，仅含分子对接预测蛋白-配体互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Bone regeneration depends on the coordinated interplay of cellular differentiation and extracellular matrix (ECM) organization. Dermatopontin (DPT), a non-collagenous ECM protein, is essential for collagen fibrillogenesis and cell-matrix interactions, particularly during wound healing. Bioinformatic analysis of DPT from the marine mollusk Haliotis diversicolor reveals a conserved RFK motif known to activate TGF-beta signaling, suggesting that it may also be involved in osteogenesis, a process that requires collagen deposition in the ECM. This study examined the osteogenic potential of recombinant DPT (rDPT) and a synthetic short peptide containing the RFK motif (1RFK-DPT) in MC3T3-E1 pre-osteoblasts. Both rDPT and 1RFK-DPT demonstrated non-cytotoxicity in MC3T3-E1 cells and upregulated the expression of key osteogenic marker genes, including RUNX2, OSX, ALP, OPN, COL1A1, and OCN. Translationally, rDPT increased COL1A1 protein expression and its deposition, as demonstrated by Western blotting and immunofluorescence analysis, as well as enhanced ECM mineralization, as shown by Alizarin Red S staining. In silico molecular docking supported a potential interaction between the RFK motif and the latent TGF-beta complex. Additionally, rDPT rapidly induced Smad2 phosphorylation within 15 min of treatment, which was effectively blocked by SB-431542, a specific inhibitor of the TGF-beta type I receptor (ALK5), indicating that DPT acts through the canonical TGF-beta/Smad signaling pathway. In summary, both full-length rDPT and 1RFK-DPT peptides enhance osteogenesis by promoting osteoblast differentiation and matrix mineralization via TGF-beta/Smad signaling activation. These results expand the list of marine-derived bioactive compounds with a potential for bone regenerative medicine.
abstract_zh: 骨再生依赖于细胞分化与细胞外基质（ECM）组织的协调相互作用。Dermatopontin（DPT）是一种非胶原性ECM蛋白，对于胶原纤维形成和细胞-基质相互作用至关重要，尤其在伤口愈合过程中。对海洋软体动物杂色鲍（Haliotis diversicolor）DPT的生物信息学分析揭示了一个保守的RFK基序，已知该基序可激活TGF-beta信号通路，提示其可能也参与成骨过程，而该过程需要ECM中的胶原沉积。本研究考察了重组DPT（rDPT）及含有RFK基序的合成短肽（1RFK-DPT）在MC3T3-E1前成骨细胞中的成骨潜力。rDPT和1RFK-DPT在MC3T3-E1细胞中均表现出无细胞毒性，并上调关键成骨标志基因的表达，包括RUNX2、OSX、ALP、OPN、COL1A1和OCN。在翻译水平上，rDPT增加了COL1A1蛋白表达及其沉积，如Western blotting和免疫荧光分析所示，并增强了ECM矿化，如Alizarin Red S染色所示。计算机分子对接支持RFK基序与潜伏TGF-beta复合物之间的潜在相互作用。此外，rDPT在处理后15分钟内迅速诱导Smad2磷酸化，该效应可被SB-431542（一种TGF-beta I型受体（ALK5）的特异性抑制剂）有效阻断，表明DPT通过经典TGF-beta/Smad信号通路发挥作用。总之，全长rDPT和1RFK-DPT肽均通过激活TGF-beta/Smad信号通路促进成骨细胞分化和基质矿化，从而增强成骨作用。这些结果扩展了具有骨再生医学潜力的海洋来源生物活性化合物的列表。
